description.zh-CN: 站在 Komari Next 与 PurCarte 肩膀上的磨砂玻璃主题：极光底、总览大盘（含最近到期）、可扩展节点卡片网格。灵感来源 Komari Next（MIT）与 PurCarte（MIT），代码为原创实现。
description.en: A frosted-glass Komari theme standing on the shoulders of Komari Next and PurCarte (both MIT; original code): aurora backdrop, overview strip with nearest expiry, and a node card grid that scales to any fleet size.
